articles.title: IPA Capital Markets Arranges $50 Million Financing For 18-Property Industrial Portfolio
articles.snippet:
IPA Capital Markets arranged $50 million in financing for an 18-property industrial portfolio located across Texas, Oklahoma, and Georgia.
The post IPA Capital Markets Arranges $50 Million Financing For 18-Property Industrial Portfolio appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
IPA Capital Markets Arranges $50 Million Financing For 18-Property Industrial Portfolio
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 11, 2026
IPA Capital Markets Arranges $50 Million Financing For 18-Property Industrial Portfolio
IPA Capital Markets arranged $50 million in financing for an 18-property industrial portfolio located across Texas, Oklahoma, and Georgia.
Frank Montalto, Managing Director, and Ethan Splan, Director, arranged the financing on behalf of the borrower.
The non-recourse loan carries a five-year term and was structured at a 70% loan-to-value ratio.
The financing carries a 6.75% interest rate, with interest-only payments for the full five-year term.
The structure provides the sponsor with long-term financing while preserving cash flow through the interest-only payment schedule.
The transaction also reflects continued lender interest in diversified industrial portfolios across growth-oriented markets in the Southern U.S.
IPA Capital Markets is a division of Marcus & Millichap that provides financing solutions for major private and institutional commercial real estate investors.
The platform works across a wide range of capital structures, including senior debt, mezzanine financing, preferred equity, joint venture equity, and sponsor equity.
Its team supports clients across acquisitions, refinancing transactions, recapitalizations, and broader portfolio financing needs.
The $50 million industrial portfolio financing adds to IPA Capital Markets’ activity across institutional and private commercial real estate transactions.
Parent company Marcus & Millichap maintains a large national commercial real estate transaction platform.
During 2025, Marcus & Millichap closed 8,818 transactions representing approximately $50.8 billion in total sales volume.
The firm’s scale, lender relationships, and capital markets capabilities provide IPA Capital Markets with access to a broad range of financing sources across different property types and transaction structures.
KEY QUOTES:
“This financing reflects the continued strength of well-located industrial assets and the durability of lender demand for stabilized portfolios with strong fundamentals. We were pleased to secure non-recourse financing with competitive leverage and pricing that supports the sponsor’s long-term business plan across these markets.”
Frank Montalto, Managing Director at IPA Capital Markets

articles.title: Innovative Industrial Properties Prices $50 Million Preferred Stock Offering
articles.snippet:
Innovative Industrial Properties priced a public offering of 2 million shares of its 9.25% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock at $25 per share, expected to raise $50 million in gross proceeds.
The post Innovative Industrial Properties Prices $50 Million Preferred Stock Offering appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Innovative Industrial Properties Prices $50 Million Preferred Stock Offering
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 10, 2026
Innovative Industrial Properties Prices $50 Million Preferred Stock Offering
Innovative Industrial Properties priced a public offering of 2 million shares of its 9.25% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock at $25 per share, expected to raise $50 million in gross proceeds.
The company granted the offering’s underwriters a 30-day option to purchase as many as an additional 300,000 preferred shares at the public offering price to cover potential overallotments.
Innovative Industrial Properties plans to apply to list the Series B Preferred Stock on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker “IIPR Pr B.”
The company’s common stock already trades on the NYSE under the IIPR ticker.
The offering is expected to close on October 19, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
Innovative Industrial Properties plans to use the net proceeds to fund all or part of its remaining unfunded commitment associated with a previously announced mezzanine loan investment in the life sciences sector.
Any remaining proceeds are expected to support investments consistent with the company’s broader investment strategy and general corporate purposes.
Innovative Industrial Properties is an internally managed REIT focused on specialized properties leased to state-licensed operators of regulated cannabis facilities, along with financial investments in the life sciences industry.
Support: Stifel is serving as active bookrunner. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, Huntington Capital Markets, and Oppenheimer & Co. are serving as passive bookrunners. Academy Securities, Clear Street, Compass Point, Roberts & Ryan, Roth Capital Partners, and Wolfe Capital Markets and Advisory are serving as co-managers.

articles.title: Atrium Therapeutics Raises $50 Million Private Placement To Advance Precision Cardiology Pipeline
articles.snippet:
Atrium Therapeutics entered into a securities purchase agreement with institutional investors for a $50 million private placement to support development of its precision cardiology pipeline.
The post Atrium Therapeutics Raises $50 Million Private Placement To Advance Precision Cardiology Pipeline appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Atrium Therapeutics Raises $50 Million Private Placement To Advance Precision Cardiology Pipeline
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 10, 2026
Atrium Therapeutics Raises $50 Million Private Placement To Advance Precision Cardiology Pipeline
Atrium Therapeutics entered into a securities purchase agreement with institutional investors for a $50 million private placement to support development of its precision cardiology pipeline.
Investors participating in the financing include Sirenia Capital Management, Aberdeen Investments, Montanova, Sessa Capital, Casdin Capital, a life sciences-focused institutional investor, and others.
Atrium agreed to sell approximately 5.17 million common shares at $7.93 per share.
The company will also issue pre-funded warrants to purchase approximately 1.13 million common shares at $7.929 per warrant, reflecting the $7.93 common share price less the $0.001 exercise price.
The financing was priced at the market under Nasdaq rules.
Atrium expects the private placement to close on or about October 9, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
The company plans to use the proceeds, together with existing cash, cash equivalents, and investments, to fund development of its two lead product candidates, additional research programs, working capital, and general corporate purposes.
Atrium estimates that the financing and its existing capital will fund operations through 2028.
The company’s lead program, ATR 1072, is being developed for PRKAG2 syndrome.
The FDA has cleared Atrium’s IND for ATR 1072, allowing the company to advance the program into the Corventis Phase 1/2 clinical trial.
Atrium is also developing ATR 1086 for PLN cardiomyopathy.
Its pipeline includes two additional undisclosed research programs targeting rare cardiomyopathies.
Atrium’s technology uses targeted delivery approaches designed to transport RNA therapeutics directly to the heart.
The platform combines the tissue selectivity of monoclonal antibodies and other targeting ligands with oligonucleotide therapeutics, including small interfering RNA.
The technology was originally developed at Avidity Biosciences.
Support: Leerink Partners served as lead placement agent. Cantor, Barclays, and Wells Fargo Securities also served as placement agents.

articles.title: FIRY To Redeem Remaining $49.7 Million Of Notes And Complete $300 Million Debt Repayment
articles.snippet:
FIRY has issued notice to redeem the remaining approximately $49.7 million principal amount of its 10.25% secured notes due 2026, completing repayment of a $300 million debt issuance ahead of maturity.
The post FIRY To Redeem Remaining $49.7 Million Of Notes And Complete $300 Million Debt Repayment appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
FIRY To Redeem Remaining $49.7 Million Of Notes And Complete $300 Million Debt Repayment
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 6, 2026
FIRY To Redeem Remaining $49.7 Million Of Notes And Complete $300 Million Debt Repayment
FIRY has issued notice to redeem the remaining approximately $49.7 million principal amount of its 10.25% secured notes due 2026, completing repayment of a $300 million debt issuance ahead of maturity.
The redemption is scheduled for October 15, 2026.
FIRY will redeem the remaining notes at 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest through, but excluding, the redemption date.
Following the redemption and satisfaction and discharge of the related indenture, FIRY expects to have no remaining notes outstanding and no outstanding indebtedness for borrowed money.
Liens securing the debt will also be released, and FIRY will no longer be subject to the covenants contained in the note indenture.
The company plans to fund the redemption with proceeds from the previously announced sale of its equity stake in Exit Games.
FIRY expects the October redemption alone to save approximately $800,000 in cash interest.
Combined with a separate August 2026 redemption, the debt repayment actions are expected to save approximately $3.6 million in interest that otherwise would have accrued through the notes’ December 15, 2026 maturity date.
FIRY expects to enter 2027 without outstanding borrowed debt.
The company plans to direct the resulting financial flexibility toward its businesses while considering future debt financing when management believes leverage could improve equity returns.
KEY QUOTES:
“The December 15 debt wall is coming down. This redemption completes the retirement of our $300 million Notes ahead of their maturity, with no new capital raised and no shareholder dilution. We believe we have the capital to run and grow our businesses and fund our litigation if necessary. Going forward, we expect to use debt when we believe it can enhance equity returns. The next chapter is about what we build from here.”
Andrew Paradise, CEO and Founder of FIRY
“Retiring the Notes is another step in our 100-year journey. We expect to enter 2027 without outstanding borrowed debt and with greater flexibility. Without debt service, more cash will be available to invest in the businesses as we focus on growing revenue and AEBITDA, supporting our guidance of modest positive operating cash flow in 2027 and revenue more than doubling from 2025 to 2028. We will consider debt in the future when we believe it enhances equity returns.”
Alex Walsh, CFO of FIRY
